proofReview.completeTree: Each successive routing decision uses the next low bit of root-entry index, yielding h-bit reversal. Every node spanning2^j leaves receives2^j entries in a complete P-entry period.
proofReview.pruningProjection: Every all-dead subtree emits no trigger and returns to root regardless of its internal switch state. Replacing it by one direct root edge removes only deleted state events and preserves retained-node event/state order.
proofReview.firstStopAndReset: The last complete-tree leaf P-1 is retained and is the unique0 output. Every earlier retained output is positive; every removed subtree points to negative root. First return0 thus occurs after exactly A and a complete projected period, with every allocated switch visited a positive even number of times. Continuing from the actual final states repeats A.
proofReview.budget: Right suffix K=N+1 intersects ceil(K/2^j) aligned blocks at levelj. S=sumceil=N-popcount(N)+h<=N+floorlog2N; T=sum2^j*ceil<=Ph<=4718592. Fullscore/hard400000/20m hold over full original domain.
proofReview.implementation: One visible complete C++20 fence. Root is first allocated switch-1; no vector references survive recursive allocation. All label assignments consumed N+1 live leaves. Array dimensions/serials meet original contract.
proofReview.api: Checks M/N/all symbols before constructing output; input unchanged. Construction is stateless with no grader link dependency. Returned vectors own storage; independent calls and value copies do not share mutable state. Initial allX execution contract is explicit; arbitraryY is not promised.
proofReview.integerAndRecursion: After bounds checks N+1<=200001,P<=262144,h<=18,first+last<=524288; switch serials/int casts safe on the tested32bit-int target. Balanced recursion has<=19 live frames. ConstructionO(M+Nlog(N+1)), storageO(M+N).

reproducedChecker.scope: Actual article fence, literal current-exit-then-toggle simulator; all small sequences and two consecutive periods without resetting final states. All-N budget arithmetic is separate from sampled actual construction; does not claim every large N circuit was built.

result.oracle: suffix subtree split: S=1+Sleft+Sright,T=span+Tleft+Tright; all-dead child contributes zero

independentAdditionalProbe.independence: Oracle recursively splits spatial surviving suffix, counting one retained root and its full-span visits. It does not use ceiling or popcount formulas to produce S/T; those are compared afterward. Wrong time-prefix pruning is rejected atN4.
